classifier.name: aerosense_cnn_v1
classifier.architecture: AeroSenseCNN (4 conv blocks + GAP + FC head)

autoencoder.name: aerosense_autoencoder_v1
autoencoder.anomaly_threshold_fit_method: max-F1 sweep over validation-set reconstruction errors (200-point linspace between observed min/max)

limitations: Classes are propeller-damage-severity classes from a single real dataset (normal / 1_broken / 2_broken / 3_4_broken), not a general bearing/motor/aircraft-engine fault taxonomy — no reachable dataset covered those.

Only a CNN was trained to convergence; CRNN/Transformer architectures were not trained due to single-CPU-core compute constraints in this environment (see training/ for untrained-but-implemented alternatives if applicable).
Segments are 2-second, 50%-overlap windows from 293 real indoor flight recordings; the model has not been validated on outdoor or fixed-wing audio.
